headline: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña Resigns Amid Banking Scandal
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña has resigned from office following a political crisis linked to a banking scandal. The departure marks the loss of a key regional ally for the current US and Argentine administrations.
why: Political instability in emerging markets often leads to currency volatility and uncertainty regarding fiscal policy and foreign investment.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Political leadership changes create uncertainty for national economic policy and stability.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The sudden resignation of a head of state creates immediate political uncertainty, which typically triggers risk-off sentiment in local financial markets and currency fluctuations.
